source.evidence: (R) Local enemy behaviour: the melee values are this build's original constants; the skittish cycle is the owner's 2026-10-15 design for the Troll Summoner (Research/Owner Field Notes); no original server AI parameters are recovered.

Troll Summoner in 'Troll Summoner Madness!' (three archived runs): stands far off under its boss bar, is far away again after one to three hits, raises helpers from earth mounds that already carry a health bar, never attacks itself. Robgoblin Adept: teleports away at low health and restores about half its bar, twice. The other presets follow the pattern table of the combat evidence (enemies 4.3).

Live capture, March 2014: an open-world enemy gives up, runs home at speed 10.0 under state 0x4001 with effect tag 2 / effect 5; idle is state 0x1 and fighting 0x8001; battle wolves rush 2.2 s after they spawn.

(R) Every threshold, distance, timer, count and line of speech in the rules below, the join radius of 6 m and the effect ids under `visuals`. Battle 96's roster has Scoutlings and Ragelings only, so `troll_summoner` raises those; `troll_summoner_2009` is the older five-kind ladder for a fight that has those actors.

visuals.note: (R) com_cast_02, com_spawn, PFX_bones_yellow_troll-spawn, PFX_smoke_black_explosion, PFX_Teleport_Flash. The live game's choices are not recovered.

field_roamer.note: (R) Starting-region field population: idle roam, chase and melee. The 12 m leash is the same local boundary as W105/W102; no original overworld AI parameters were recovered. Noticing, the leash, the run home and the respawn are the field's own rules; each row's aggro range decides when it gets a target.

melee.note: (R) Chase and swing; the build's original enemy constants. The default for enemies without a behaviour.

skittish.note: (R) The owner's first design for the Troll Summoner, 2026-10-15: fights beside its summoned minions; alone it runs 4 s (slower than a running player), rests 3 s playing com_stunned (the window to hit it), then runs again, within 12 m of its spawn. In a battle whose helpers carry summon_below_percent the loader adds the ladder: wake the helpers and fight beside them, flee again when they are gone.

stationary.note: (R) Never moves; swings at players within reach. For turrets, totems and guards that hold a doorway.

troll_summoner.note: The owner's example (the 'goblin summoner'): keeps its distance, is somewhere else after two hits, raises helpers from earth mounds and repeats; it never attacks, and its helpers outlive it. Written for battle 96's roster (Scoutlings and Ragelings); a fallen helper can be raised again.

troll_summoner_2009.note: The 2009-10 ladder read from video: Runtlings out at the start, then Scoutling, Novice Archer, Ragelings and Young Guardians as its health falls. Needs a fight that has those actors asleep.

robgoblin_adept.note: Flee, heal, return: casts fast at range, teleports out of reach at low health and restores about half its bar, twice.

bixie_soldier.note: Open-world notice, chase, give up (captured): the field roamer with the captured bite rhythm.

frostfang_wave_wolf.note: Rush from anywhere (captured): 2.2 s after it spawns it runs straight at the nearest player.

robgoblin_boomer.note: Stand and throw: does not move, lobs a bomb on a fixed rhythm at where its target stands, no retreat.

rowdy_hooligan.note: Call for help by speech: helpers tagged hooligan_pack arrive two seconds after the shout.

say.text: Drone Fauzz prepares for a big attack!

drone_fauzz.note: Announced special: a system line, three seconds, then a knock-down around it.

necronomicus.note: Phase, intermission object, second form. (R) The intermission starts just before zero health, so the first form is never seen falling; the spoken line is ours.

grave_elemental.note: Feeds on objects: draws health from bone clusters while any stands.

spawner_object.note: Bat Spawner, Zombie Portal, spider eggs: an object that releases small enemies until destroyed. A row changes the kind.

wizard_hildegarde.note: Boss as stage host: a talk-to character who releases a pack per talk and is attackable only at the end.

zandro_rageracer.note: Timed adds and a stunning heavy hit; sticks to its target.
